verdict.rationale: AgentMail provides the building blocks for background automation—webhooks and persistent WebSocket connections that push email events in real time instead of requiring polling—so an agent can react autonomously to inbound mail without a human in the loop. However, AgentMail itself is just email infrastructure; there's no evidence of a built-in scheduler, workflow engine, or persistent agent runtime that executes autonomous logic—that has to be built by the user on top of the webhook/websocket feed. Missing for 10: evidence of a native scheduling/automation engine, documented autonomous background job execution, or independent confirmation that these mechanisms reliably drive unattended agent workflows.
